title: Vision-Guided Robotic Insertion with YOLOv11-OBB and UR5e — archived controller logs
finding: 77 distinct archived CSVs, 257,647 controller rows, visual detections and requested twist. Three log files expose unclipped TCP translation requests and recorded outputs. Physical force, actual twist, electrical state, mechanical seating, and per-insertion success are absent.
rights: Default branch gives MIT for project; RTDE and weights have upstream terms. Separate raw data license not identified. Only original derived counts and checksums shared.

title: TacRich-Manip LeRobot v3 — insert_peg_cylinder
finding: All 79 real-robot episodes, 44 data Parquet shards and 109,073 complete two-pad tactile frames and corresponding timestamp/ID columns. Source-clock fallback allowed; no physical port contact switch, calibrated net force or verified per-trial success flag.
rights: Apache-2.0 per public, ungated dataset card. Authored statistics only. Original depth and RGB excluded.

title: Peak-to-plateau axial force changes and stable resistance during three-step canted-coil mating
authors: Chao Zhang; Hongcheng Chen; Wanbin Ren; Jian Liu
finding: Three stage-level summaries of one insertion sequence. New table computes differences and resistance ratios between successive stable states.
rights: Underlying publication CC BY-NC 4.0, attribution above, noncommercial reuse of adapted data. Original waveforms unavailable here.

title: Change of fitted contact-resistance degradation parameters with cycle count
authors: Ping Qian; Qiqi Chen; Chi Chen; Jun Pan; Kunkun Han
finding: Ten points indexed every 100 cycles. Derived changes of the fitted parameter means and variances, not individual force or resistance measurements.
rights: CC BY 4.0. Derived differences from Qian et al., Table 2.
